description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在透過國際新聞的商管題材，全面提升學生的聽、讀英語技能，同時拓展學生的國際視野與專業競爭力。課程內容將聚焦於真實且實用的商業情境，透過多元素材如國際趨勢新聞、商業報告、會議錄音及簡報，讓學生能夠在理解專業知識的同時，提升英語應用能力，特別是在商務溝通和資訊分析方面。
description.describe_eh: This course focuses on enhancing students' English listening and reading skills through international news business topics. By using real-world materials like trend reports, business articles, and presentations, students will improve their English proficiency, expand global perspectives, and strengthen business communication and analytical skills.

Objective: Train students to understand meetings, presentations, and business calls in real-world business contexts.

閱讀訓練：商業文件解析
目標：提高學生閱讀理解能力，能有效閱讀報告、電郵及商業文章。
targets.describe_en:
Reading Training: Analysis of Business Documents
Objective: Improve students' reading comprehension skills to effectively understand reports, emails, and business articles.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 希望同學能夠在這一堂商用英文課當中能夠習得國際趨勢以及語言的訓練以提升多益的程度，因此課堂上同學的出席率，要自我要求。課堂上會有討論與分享盡量參與。多多参與以及期中考期末考一定要出席參加，否則對成績會有影響。本課程期望學生能在全英語環境中積極練習，培養良好溝通能力與課堂表達技巧。請準時到課並全程專心參與，課堂中鼓勵討論與分享觀點，提升彼此學習成效。若需請假務必事先告知，避免影響成績評量,尤其期中考和期末考。希望大家以正向態度投入課程，共同打造良好的學習氛圍。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
學生應積極參與所有以英語進行的課堂活動。規律出席與準時上課是必要的，因為持續的語言接觸是英文能力提升的關鍵。所有作業需按時繳交；若逾期繳交，除非事先獲得批准，否則可能會被扣分。

本課程嚴格遵守學術誠信原則。任何形式的抄襲、作弊或未經授權的合作皆不被允許，並可能導致校方的處分。所有作業須正確引用並清楚標明資料來源。

課堂上應保持尊重的交流態度與積極的學習心態。學生需共同營造一個支持性的學習環境，將錯誤視為學習的機會。遵守這些規範，學生將能穩步進步，並充分受益於全英語的學習環境。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 學生應遵守學術誠信，不抄襲、不作弊，積極參與課堂互動，誠實完成學習評量。若有違反學術誠信規定者，將依校規處分，包含成績扣減或課程不及格。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity Statement and Course Description
 
This course is designed to provide students with a fully immersive English environment, where communication, discussion, and learning take place entirely in English. By engaging with course materials, interactive tasks, and peer collaboration, students are encouraged to develop their language skills naturally and progressively. The aim is not only to improve grammar, vocabulary, and comprehension, but also to build confidence in using English in both academic and practical contexts. Through consistent exposure, students will gradually enhance their fluency and critical thinking in English.
 
At the same time, academic integrity is a fundamental principle of this course. Students are expected to complete all assignments and assessments honestly, ensuring that their work reflects personal effort and genuine understanding. Plagiarism, cheating, or misuse of digital or AI tools is not permitted. Proper acknowledgment of sources must always be observed. By maintaining integrity, students protect the fairness of the learning environment and the value of their progress.
 
This course therefore combines two key elements: an English-only setting that fosters long-term language improvement, and a commitment to honesty and responsibility that ensures meaningful academic growth.
